Prerequisites

  # Need API_TOKEN set (personal access token for the package registry)
  export API_TOKEN='<your-api-token>'

  # Set kubectl context to the right cluster
  az aks get-credentials --resource-group example-rg --name example-cluster

  # Must run from the deploy dir
  cd ~/.config/example-deploy

  helm repo update && \
  helm template example-api example-charts/app \
    --values config/example-values.yaml \
    --namespace example-ns | \
  kubectl apply -f -

  kubectl get pods -n example-ns | grep -E "example-api|example-worker"
